ops.title: Codex fleet follow-up: browser fixed, generated captain-hook skills remain Claude-specific
ops.body: Follow-up review accepted the browser user-input fix and independently verified the required-artifact and full-catalog builder corrections. The remaining package finding is in the supplied generated Captain Hook Codex root: three exposed skill bodies still require Claude-only interaction, paths, and validation commands. The attached report carries exact triggers, evidence, verified fixes, and limits.
